parameters.query:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT from_numero, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM giulia_memoria
  WHERE from_numero IS NOT NULL AND from_numero != ''
  GROUP BY from_numero
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
),
old_msgs AS (
  SELECT m.from_numero,
         array_agg(m.role || ': ' || m.content ORDER BY m.created_at ASC) AS msgs,
         MIN(m.created_at) AS periodo_inicio,
         MAX(m.created_at) AS periodo_fim,
         COUNT(*) AS msg_count,
         array_agg(m.id ORDER BY m.created_at ASC) AS ids
  FROM giulia_memoria m
  JOIN counts c ON c.from_numero = m.from_numero
  WHERE m.id NOT IN (
    SELECT id FROM giulia_memoria mm
    WHERE mm.from_numero = m.from_numero
    ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 30
  )
  GROUP BY m.from_numero
)
SELECT o.from_numero, array_to_string(o.msgs, E'\n') AS texto_conversas, o.periodo_inicio, o.periodo_fim, o.msg_count, o.ids,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(d.nome_completo, ''), NULLIF(d.nome, ''), o.from_numero) AS dono_nome
FROM old_msgs o
LEFT JOIN giulia_donos d ON d.numero = o.from_numero
LIMIT 10;
